lessonPurpose: Teach 'फूल और काँटा' as a reasoning-rich learning experience, not a recall exercise.
context: The lesson should keep भाव और विचार की समझ, शब्दार्थ और संदर्भ and पाठ से प्रमाण visible as the chapter's organising ideas.
teacherMoves: Begin with a question that activates prior knowledge about भाव और विचार की समझ.
Use a concrete chapter example to make शब्दार्थ और संदर्भ observable.
Model one complete reasoning step involving पाठ से प्रमाण.
Ask learners to challenge or improve an explanation about भाषिक अभिव्यक्ति.
Use an error involving सृजनात्मक लेखन as diagnostic evidence rather than simply marking it wrong.
End with a transfer task connected to पठन-समझ.
discussionPrompts: What evidence supports your idea about भाव और विचार की समझ?
What evidence supports your idea about शब्दार्थ और संदर्भ?
What evidence supports your idea about पाठ से प्रमाण?
What evidence supports your idea about भाषिक अभिव्यक्ति?
What evidence supports your idea about सृजनात्मक लेखन?
What evidence supports your idea about पठन-समझ?
checksForUnderstanding: Can the learner explain भाव और विचार की समझ without copying the textbook?
Can the learner explain शब्दार्थ और संदर्भ without copying the textbook?
Can the learner explain पाठ से प्रमाण without copying the textbook?
Can the learner explain भाषिक अभिव्यक्ति without copying the textbook?
Can the learner explain सृजनात्मक लेखन without copying the textbook?
Can the learner explain पठन-समझ without copying the textbook?
home_or_extension: Ask learners to find one real-life example of जीवन से संबंध and explain how it relates to 'फूल और काँटा'.
